scope: One bounded outer-generator path audit plus deterministic execution of the native integer RNG helpers. The four-slot 0x529910 body and 0x528bf0 setup are not invoked in this iteration.

evidence_labels.NATIVE: ELF instructions, call sites, and bounded original-instruction harness results.
evidence_labels.PSEUDO: Control-flow interpretation derived from the native instruction sequence/decompilation.
evidence_labels.TBL: Raw BCSV/BYML data read from the supplied additional RomFS and cross-checked with committed summaries.
evidence_labels.EF: Inference or limitation requiring unavailable PBC payloads or unexecuted runtime resource state.

generator_path.label: [NATIVE] call graph / [PSEUDO] execution order
per_slot_flow: 0x529910 builds a row-eligibility bitset from FieldMainFieldParam.
The original xorshift draw is multiplied by the eligible count; 0x52a110 returns the ranked source row, then its bit is removed.
0x54e190 binds the source row and 0x54e330 reads OutsideTemplateKind.
0x552bb0 selects a FieldOutsideTemplate UniqueID for that category using the shared RNG state.
0x529910 constructs a 0xe0-byte setup parameter with the source-row UID, selected template UID and slot index, then calls 0x528bf0.
0x528bf0 calls 0x558f40 only when the template resource and destination grid are non-null.
generator_path.native_execution_status: [NATIVE] The standalone RNG seed-expansion and eight draw steps pass. [PSEUDO] The parent generator sequence is documented from code and its four call sites; this iteration does not invoke 0x529910 or 0x528bf0.

rng.scope: Original seed expansion and xorshift instructions ran natively on a deterministic seed. This does not execute 0x529910's GetSystemTick-seeded constructor or its caller draw order.

preset_to_runtime.label: [NATIVE] field transfer / [EF] PBC and transform join

call_chain.evidence: four repeated generation slots call the preset setup function

call_chain.condition: preset resource and destination grid pointers are non-null

grid_iteration.coordinates: passed to destination grid accessors; out-of-range coordinates are skipped

wrapper_backing_store.payload_accessor_rule: 0x55ac40 returns this+0x28; constructor copies at returned_pointer+8, i.e. constructor_object+0xf0.
wrapper_backing_store.interpretation: The wrapper's inline backing buffer begins at constructor_object+0xf0 and has the same total size as the decoded 14-byte preset grid.
wrapper_backing_store.does_not_prove: This size match does not establish that the wrapper buffer is the destination accessor's cell storage or the separate 52-byte ground/collision grid.

native_transfer.write_offsets_note: Offsets are relative to the cell pointer returned by the destination grid accessor. The accessor's internal allocation/chunk stride is not established here.
native_transfer.unit_id_rule: Source ID is copied unless it equals the native empty-unit sentinel; that value is replaced by the native default-unit ID. Sentinel/default runtime values were not resolved.
native_transfer.variation_rule: The loader looks up the destination unit's FieldUnitParam Variation u16 limit (CRC32 0xc733aa77); a source variation index greater than the limit is reset to 0, otherwise it is copied.
native_transfer.height_rule: The source height byte is copied to cell offset 12. Downstream height accessor 0xf52860 clamps values above 5 to 4; all decoded presets in this corpus contain heights 0–3.

preset_to_runtime.join_status: [EF] 0x558f40 transfers the 14-byte preset schema into destination LandMaking cell fields; it does not expand the cell into the separate 52-byte ground/PBC record. ModelName + '_pbc' resource naming is statically cataloged, but payload values are absent from both this partial RomFS and the indexed source corpus.
preset_to_runtime.transform_status: [EF] The 2x2 PBC-per-unit and 5.0-unit PBC cell model is carried by earlier audit metadata; the exact 14-byte cell to PBC subcell rotation/origin/height transform and runtime cache bootstrap are not proven by this loader.
preset_to_runtime.variation_cache_rule: The loader looks up the destination unit's FieldUnitParam Variation u16 limit (CRC32 0xc733aa77); a source variation index greater than the limit is reset to 0, otherwise it is copied.
preset_to_runtime.height_rule: The source height byte is copied to cell offset 12. Downstream height accessor 0xf52860 clamps values above 5 to 4; all decoded presets in this corpus contain heights 0–3.

missing_assets.blocker: The user-supplied additional RomFS is partial and contains no PBC-named payloads; exact 52-byte record join and per-cell transform cannot be validated from missing asset bytes.

assertions_passed: Raw additional BCSV row counts: FieldMainFieldParam=96, FieldOutsideTemplate=36, FieldLandMakingUnitModelParam=246.
FieldMainFieldParam contains 96 unique preset UIDs and category counts 30/33/33 for OutsideTemplateKind 0..2.
The additional RomFS contains 96 LandMaking preset BYML files.
Disassembled ELF direct BL targets match the index.sqlite call graph; 0x529910 has exactly four 0x552bb0 and four 0x528bf0 calls, and 0x528bf0 directly references 0x558f40.
The 14-byte destination field offsets are [0,2,4,6,8,10,12], and the separate runtime/PBC record stride is 52 bytes.
No PBC-named file is present in the additional RomFS or index.sqlite.
Original native RNG seed expansion and eight deterministic u32 draws match independent arithmetic with unchanged state transitions.
